blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police arrested two suspects shortly after a shooting incident involving two motorcycle riders in Victoria town on Tuesday morning. The Victoria Municipal Police Station said the shootout occurred around 9:10 a.m. in Barangay San Narciso. The motorcycle riders were allegedly approached by two men who drew out guns and fired at them, according to police.
